changes: Move the existing foliage wind, normals and BlinnPhong lighting into a fixed shader; preserve all vegetation and official auxiliary passes.
Remove now-unused foliage branches from the solid-surface shader.
Disable the opaque color copy: no project shader samples CameraOpaqueTexture, and the only renderer feature is SSAO.
Use subtle derivative-filtered fabric weave; the coarse candidate from run-012-v5 was rejected and corrected in run-013-v5.
limitations: The old mixed shader returned SRP code 1, Not initialized; this does not prove incompatibility.
The diagnostic draw-omission experiment is not a measurement of the shipping shader speedup.
Final performance is recorded in the actual native and browser runtime results, with the new character included.
